name: Ergasterion lessons
say: This week we wrote down 7 lessons. The strongest (3 files agree): No edge found. None of them beat the noise bar on the training data, so none was carried forward. What changed our mind: Uncorrelated, but it does not hold in 2021-25 and passes evals too slowly.

top.text: 2,520 context variants were tested on today's live LIT trades and on the adopt-candidate combo (t_check + scale_in + be_off).
No edge found. None of them beat the noise bar on the training data, so none was carried forward.
None gives an edge that survives fees, a held-out block and a second asset.
No single fact has a bin that loses in both halves; 425 two-fact loser cells picked on Jan-Jun keep losing in Jul-Oct 88 times against 95 expected by chance.

(1m for 2026, 5m for 2021-25), costs in ($1.90 a micro, 1 tick on every market and stop fill, limits only when traded through, every same-bar tie booked against us), picked on 2026 Jan-Jun, checked on Jul-Oct, 2021-25 o…
Only 10 of 141 add money in both halves (about 12 expected by chance) and none of those reaches 3 trades a week in Jul-Oct without raising the eval fail rate.
Not adopted on money (fails H1), a risk choice for the owner.

changed.text: Uncorrelated, but it does not hold in 2021-25 and passes evals too slowly.
One pocket looked real (and replicated across two assets) until I ran it on two months of data it had never seen: it vanished.

The earlier finding "95c and above is +1.4% per $" came from the bot's own bets (no market-wide data). On the market-wide data it is +0.1% (train) and -0.6% (test): that pocket is not an edge, it is the bot's entry timing plus luck.
The H2 gain of the pick (fail in 2 weeks 17.4% vs 21.7%) rests on 31 trades and does not hold in 2021-25.
If shuffled outcomes do as well, the previous result carries no information.

note: Every lesson is a sentence lifted from a file in the repo; strength = how many independent files agree. Research notes, never a trade signal.
